Flip and toast the other side, in batches.Cut into fingers and sprinkle with chives.Bathtub ocean prawn cocktail glassesThe bathtub that turns into an oceanHow to make itAs written, serves 4Poached prawns on shredded lettuce in small glasses with a cocktail sauce of mayo, tomato sauce and lemon.Peel and devein 600g cooked king prawns, leaving a few tails on for the rims.Mix 120g whole egg mayonnaise with 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp Worcestershire, a few drops of Tabasco and the juice of half a lemon.Shred half an iceberg lettuce and divide between 4 glasses.Pile the prawns on top, spoon same pan until soft.Add the stock and simmer until thick.Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter and milk.Cook the peas.Serve the sausages on the mash with peas and plenty of gravy.Cherry minutes, with buttered peas.Brown 800g diced chicken thigh in 30g butter and set aside.Soften 2 sliced leeks in the same pan, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 300ml chicken stock and 150ml cream and
